title: Upgrade v0.0.7: fix EVM bridge-out (block module accounts)
summary: Coordinated software upgrade to v0.0.7 at block height 79664 (about 2026-10-24 00:00 UTC). Bridge-outs through the EVM precompile (0x...0900, e.g. from MetaMask) fail with 'is not allowed to receive funds': cosmos/evm copies a precompile's bank transfers into the EVM state, skipping only blocked accounts, and refuses to write a module account's balance, while the bridge's module accounts (steemblackhole, bridge_reward) were not blocked. v0.0.7 blocks every module account in x/bank, as upstream cosmos/evm does. No state or parameter changes; the upgrade handler only runs module migrations. Validators: stage before the height with `git fetch origin && git checkout release/v0.0.6 && git pull --ff-only && ./update.sh`; cosmovisor switches automatically at height 79664. Binary sha256 dce7841719984b4c385dee7f4131b6d58f424562c1c7dcdd78dafb189b0936cc.
